programme.desc: Razi, yang baru saja putus dengan Jessica, merasa tidak ada gunanya bekerja keras sebagai fotografer majalah. Di tengah gejolak batinnya, Razi bertemu Jane yang menawarkan pekerjaan sampingan sebagai paparazi. Akhirnya ia menerima tawaran tersebut, meskipun awalnya ingin mundur karena risikonya terlalu berbahaya. Razi kemudian pergi ke Yogyakarta bersama Jane. Awalnya, ia berniat membantu Jane menemui seorang dukun untuk melakukan sesuatu terhadap selingkuhan ayah Jane. Namun, tanpa diduga keduanya mengalami petualangan seru dan menegangkan saat disandera oleh sekte sesat Kerajaan Ilahi Kamilia di Gunung Kidul. Akibat kebersamaan dalam situasi penuh penderitaan itu, benih-benih cinta antara Razi dan Jane mulai tumbuh.

12 Hari S1 E1
programme.desc: Keluar dari penjara, Ridho (30) berusaha menyambung hidupnya dengan mencari pekerjaan di berbagai tempat. Hingga akhirnya, Ia diterima di toko kelontong milik Ibu Siti Khofifah (50). Ridho mulai mencari informasi tentang sosok pembunuh Ibunya yang tersirat didalam surat, 6 tahun lalu. Hasil penulusuran tertuju pada Annisa (30) yang bekerja di sebuah bar.

programme.title: Can EAL Break 90 At The Scottish Open
12 Hari S1 E2
programme.desc: Ridho mencari alamat yang tertera di surat, dia menemukan perusahaan ekspedisi yang mengirimkan surat itu. Dari sana, petunjuk baru membawanya ke sebuah bar, tempat Annisa berkerja. Ridho dan Annisa memiliki kenangan bersama. Petunjuk lain yang di berikan Annisa mengarah pada Geng Panjo.

programme.title: 5 Simple Ways To Fix Your Golf Hook
12 Hari S1 E3
programme.desc: Informasi tentang Geng Panjo hanya bisa didapatkan melalui Om Roy (55), narapidana yang mengajarkan Ridho cara bertahan hidup dan menghadapi kesulitan selama di penjara. Om Roy memperingatkan Ridho bahwa akan sulit melepaskan diri jika sudah terlibat, dia pun memberikan nomor telepon yang menjadi petunjuk selanjutnya.

programme.title: 12 Hari S1 E4
programme.desc: Ridho menemui Sammy (30), pemilik nomor telepon yang diberikan Om Roy. Sammy awalnya terlihat bersimpati padanya, namun ternyata ia mengepung dan mengeroyok Ridho bersama kaki tangannya. Ridho tersudutkan dan berusaha kabur. Pertemuan tersebut memang sudah direncanakan Herman (55), bos Geng Panjo sekaligus Ayahnya Sammy.

programme.title: I Built A Golf Simulator At Home
12 Hari S1 E5
programme.desc: Merasa dibohongi, Ridho kembali ke penjara untuk menghajar Om Roy. Perkelahian terjadi hingga Kepala penjara, Beni (55) melarang keras Ridho untuk kembali ke penjara. Sepulang dari penjara, Annisa menemuinya dan bersaksi bahwa Baje Bambala (50) memiliki petunjuk yang diinginkan Ridho. Annisa mendesak dan bersedia membantunya untuk bertatap muka dengan Baje.

programme.title: The 'Secret' Golf Clubs That Big Brands Don't Tell You About
Blair O'NEAL Bombs The Boulder At Troon North In Scottsdale Arizona
12 Hari S1 E6
programme.desc: Beni mempertemukan Ridho dengan Baje, terungkaplah bahwa Baje adalah Abdul, ayah kandung Ridho yang selama ini menghilang. Ridho pun marah dan membuat kegaduhan. Kali ini, Beni benar-benar melarangnya bisa masuk ke penjara lagi.

programme.title: 12 Hari S1 E7
programme.desc: Terkuak bahwa Annisa lah yang menjebak Ridho dibawa ke markas Geng Panjo. Ridho merasa dikhianati lagi, amarahnya berubah menjadi putus asa. Dalam keputusasaan, Ridho menanyakan tentang sosok Rose dan alasan membunuh Ibunya. Herman pun mengeluarkan Rose dari persembunyian dan ternyata Rose adalah Ibu Ridho sendiri, Rismah (45)

programme.title: 3V3 18 Hole Scramble - Tiger Woods Course Payne's Valley - Part 1
12 Hari S1 E8
programme.desc: Herman mengajak Ridho bertarung, namun Ridho terkalahkan. Herman pun menawari Ridho untuk menjadi anggota Geng Panjo, sebagai gantinya Rismah (45), Ibunya akan dibebaskan, Ridho pun setuju. Untuk membuktikan keseriusannya, Ridho harus memenuhi satu syarat yaitu membunuh Om Roy yang mendekam di penjara hanya dalam waktu 24 jam.

programme.title: Sporty Summer Outfits Of The Week - Golf Lookbook Vlog
12 Hari S1 E9
programme.desc: Ridho meminta bantuan Dadang (25) dan Fahrul (40), teman satu selnya dulu, untuk membuat kerusuhan. Saat kerusuhan terjadi, Ridho pun menyusup ke penjara dan mendatangi sel Om Roy. Ia langsung menghabisi Om Roy , namun Om Roy memperlihatkan sebuah memory card yang berisi bukti-bukti perbudakan Geng Panjo.

programme.desc: Tim SWAT datang mengepung markas Geng Panjo bersama Ridho. Namun Herman sudah mengantisapi, dengan menyandera Rismah, Annisa, dan tawanan lainnya. programme.title: Satu Hati Untuk Garuda
programme.desc: Satu Hati Untuk Garuda. Program spesial yang menampilkan semangat, dedikasi, dan dukungan tanpa henti bagi Tim Nasional Indonesia. programme.title: ACL Two 2025-2026: AHL Vs AND
programme.desc: Pertandingan ini mempertemukan Al-Ahli (AHL) dari Qatar dengan Andijon (AND) dari Uzbekistan dalam AFC Champions League Two 2025–2026. Al-Ahli merupakan klub asal Qatar dan bertindak sebagai tuan rumah dalam pertandingan ini.

programme.title: World Classic Soccer
programme.desc: Meskipun menampilkan Piala Dunia FIFA 1990 yang diadakan di Italia, permainan ini bukan bagian dari seri resmi Piala Dunia FIFA.

programme.title: Sportacular International Match
programme.desc: Sportacular International Match menyajikan pertandingan sepak bola internasional yang mempertemukan tim nasional dari berbagai belahan dunia. Tim-tim unggulan maupun negara yang sedang membangun generasi baru menguji kekuatan skuad, strategi, dan pemain muda mereka melalui laga persahabatan serta pertandingan internasional yang menjadi persiapan penting menuju turnamen besar berikutnya.

programme.title: Hyundai C'ship 2026: IDN Vs CAM
programme.desc: Pertandingan ini mempertemukan tim nasional Indonesia (IDN) dengan Kamboja (CAM) dalam ASEAN Hyundai Cup 2026. Karena Indonesia tercatat sebagai tim tuan rumah dalam pertandingan ini, laga diselenggarakan di Indonesia.

programme.title: Hyundai C'ship 2026: IDN Vs CAM

programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 1
programme.desc: Kazuma Satou, seorang remaja yang meninggal dalam kecelakaan yang memalukan, bertemu dengan Dewi Aqua di alam setelah kematian. Ia diberi kesempatan untuk bereinkarnasi ke dunia fantasi dan memilih satu benda untuk dibawa. Sebagai balas dendam atas sikap Aqua yang mengejeknya, Kazuma justru memilih sang dewi untuk ikut bersamanya. Setibanya di dunia baru, keduanya segera menyadari bahwa kehidupan sebagai petualang tidak semudah yang dibayangkan. Episode pembuka ini memperkenalkan dunia penuh sihir, monster, dan humor satir yang menjadi ciri khas KonoSuba.

programme.title: Teasing Takagi-San S3, Ep 4
programme.desc: Pada episode pembuka musim ketiga, Nishikata kembali berusaha mengalahkan Takagi dalam berbagai tantangan sederhana, mulai dari latihan kekuatan genggaman tangan, membandingkan kulit yang terbakar matahari, hingga momen-momen di awal semester baru. programme.desc: Saat mengetahui jika dirinya adalah anak adopsi, Li Ching pergi untuk mencari keluarganya. Ketika situasi yang dialaminya menjadi semakin memburuk, ia akhirnya menyadari bahwa rumah adalah tempat yang terbaik.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Mei Li muda bekerja sebagai pelayan bar di Wanchai untuk mencari nafkah. Ia jatuh cinta pada Jimmy saat bertemu dengannya di sana. Namun, Mei Li merasa sangat terpukul saat Jimmy harus pergi.

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi, seorang ahli kungfu gaya Hong Quan bekerja di pabrik tekstil yang direkomendasikan oleh Han, seniornya. Han memperingatkan Yi untuk tidak memamerkan keahlian seni bela dirinya agar tak mendapat masalah.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Ti Lung yang hidup di Gunung Ular Kwangsi bersama dengan saudaranya, Ular Hitam dan Ular Kuning, telah berusaha untuk berubah menjadi manusia selama seribu tahun.

programme.title: Return Of The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Film sekuel ini bercerita tentang imigran Yeh Feng yang kabur dari penjara untuk tinggal bersama paman Wang Sha yang jahat. Namun, ternyata kekasihnya, Ai Ti, telah menikah dengan seorang pria yang kasar.

programme.title: Legend Of The Bat
programme.desc: Pendekar pedang karismatik, Chu Liu Hsiang pergi ke Pulau Kelelawar. Di sana ia bertemu dengan para biksu, wanita serta berbagai aksi petualangan!

programme.title: The Story Of Sue San
programme.desc: Wang adalah putra pejabat pemerintah yang dihormati, sedangkan Sue San adalah seorang wanita penghibur nan terkenal. Meskipun dan terlihat cocok dan saling mencintai, keduanya sangat berbeda dalam tingkatan sosial.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Kisah legendaris yang bercerita tentang keberanian dan kepahlawanan ini dibintangi oleh Ivy Ling Po yang berperan sebagai Mulan, gadis yang bergabung dengan tentara dan menjadi pahlawan sejati bagi warga Tiongkok.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: Tiga gadis pergi ke Jepang untuk mengambil warisan yang tak terduga dan bertemu tiga pria dengan niat yang sama. Pertarungan sengit pun terjadi untuk memperebutkan warisan tersebut.

programme.title: The Cave Of Silken Web
programme.desc: Bagian ke-3 dari film Journey To The West produksi Shaw Brothers ini mengikuti perjuangan para jagoan kita saat dijebak oleh 7 siluman laba-laba penggoda, yang bertekad untuk meraih keabadian dengan memakan para biksu!

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: Seorang agen kekaisaran diejek karena berbagai penemuannya, hingga istrinya yang suportif mendorongnya untuk menghadiri sebuah konferensi, yang sebenarnya adalah jebakan untuk membunuh semua dokter yang melayani kaisar, di mana penemuan-penemuan gilanya menjadi berguna.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: Setelah menyergap dan membunuh musuh bebuyutannya, namun kehilangan segalanya dalam proses itu, panglima perang Hou Jie yang putus asa mencari penebusan dengan berlindung di sebuah biara Shaolin.

programme.title: Girl With The Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: Lily, adalah seorang gadis biasa yang menjalani kehidupan sederhana. Suatu hari, dalam sebuah pasar antik, dia menemukan sepasang sepatu kaca berlian yang indah. Tanpa disangka, sepatu ini ternyata memiliki kekuatan magis yang dapat mewujudkan impian dan memberikan keberuntungan. Ketika Lily mencoba sepatu tersebut, dia segera menemukan bahwa hidupnya mulai berubah drastis. Dia mendapatkan pekerjaan impiannya, bertemu dengan orang-orang penting, dan bahkan menarik perhatian seorang pangeran modern yang tampan.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: Selama lima tahun, Takumi yang berusia 18 tahun mengirimkan tahu setiap pagi dengan mengendarai Toyota AE86 kuno milik ayahnya. Ia pun mengembangkan teknik balap yang sempurna dan menjadi pembalap hebat.

programme.title: Jealousy

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2

programme.title: Ip Man

programme.desc: Tamotsu tewas dalam sebuah kecelakaan ski. Kemudian, teman sekamarnya, Yoshio, menikahi istrinya serta mewarisi seluruh kekayaannya. Namun, segalanya berubah sejak Yoshio bertemu seorang pria tua di pemakaman Tamotsu.

programme.title: The Great North London Divide : PL Stories
programme.desc: Set against one of the most dramatic seasons in recent memory, we explore the enduring intensity of the North London rivalry between Arsenal and Tottenham Hotspur. We trace the origins of a feud shaped by geography, identity and decades of defining moments. We interweave the story of this season, which has reshaped the balance of power in North London and brings a fresh perspective to a rivalry already steeped in history. Through iconic matches and unforgettable characters, we capture what this rivalry has meant; and what it could become, as the two clubs look ahead to an uncertain future that may yet see them competing in very different circumstances.

programme.title: Patrick Vieira : PL Moments
programme.desc: Patrick Vieira revisits the defining moments of his legendary Premier League career, counting down the 10 greatest memories from his time in England. From fierce rivalries and title triumphs to unforgettable performances in midfield, Vieira reflects on the moments that shaped his legacy as one of the Premier League's all-time greats.

programme.title: 2026/2027 : Preview Of The Season
programme.desc: The Premier League is back! Who will challenge for the title? Who can live up to the hype? And who has it all to prove? Preview of the Season will assess every club and hear from all the big names ahead of a thrilling 2026/27 campaign.

programme.title: Kevin Keegan : PL Stories
programme.desc: From fearless forward to one of English football's most inspirational figures, this is the story of Kevin Keegan. We chart his remarkable playing career with Liverpool, Hamburg and England before exploring his impact as a manager, where he inspired Newcastle United to become one of the Premier League's most captivating teams. Through triumphs, setbacks and an unwavering passion for the game, we celebrate the life and legacy of a true football icon.

programme.title: The Tigers Return : PL Stories
programme.desc: Hull City's return to the Premier League is the latest chapter in a story built on resilience, ambition and belief.? We look back on the club's previous adventures in the top-flight, reliving the moments that shaped its identity before looking ahead to an exciting new era. Joining the Tigers at their pre-season training camp in Slovenia, we go behind the scenes to discover how the club is preparing for the challenges ahead, as they aim not just to survive in the Premier League, but to establish themselves there for years to come.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Ars) : Review Of The Season
programme.desc: As we wave goodbye to another action-packed and compelling Premier League campaign, Review of the Season takes you through the twists and turns of a gripping last 10 months. From how the title was won, the fight for European spots, and the battle to avoid relegation - all the key moments are covered from another scintillating season.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Ars) : Review Of The Season
programme.desc: As we wave goodbye to another action-packed and compelling Premier League campaign, Review of the Season takes you through the twists and turns of a gripping last 10 months. programme.title: (Subbed) A Family United : PL Stories
programme.desc: 'A Family United', tells the story of the Singh brothers; lifelong Manchester United fans who have followed the club through every twist of its Premier League journey.? From the glory years under Sir Alex Fergsuson to the highs and lows that followed, the brothers relive the moments, memories and matches that shaped both their lives and their bond as a family.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Haaland) : Goals Of The Season
programme.desc: From free-kicks to solo runs, scissor kicks to 30-yard screamers, Goals of the Season revisits some of the most memorable strikes from the 25/26 campaign, whilst paying homage to the Golden Boot winner.

programme.title: Fri 14 Aug : Fantasy Show
programme.desc: Haaland or Ekitike? Saka or Palmer? Cunha or Joao Pedro? Picking your Fantasy team is never easy, but the Fantasy Show is on hand to help FPL Managers with those big decisions.

programme.title: The Ipswich Way : PL Stories
programme.desc: From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs. We celebrate the remarkable highs, the resilience through changing times, and George Burley's extraordinary achievement in guiding Ipswich Town to a fifth-place finish in their first Premier League season. As a new chapter begins with Gary O'Neil following the successful reign of Kieran McKenna, we explore how the spirit, identity and ambition of Ipswich Town continues to shape its future.

programme.title: Review
programme.desc: Review brings you all the action from Matchweek 27, as Brighton travel to Brentford, Newcastle face Manchester City in Manchester, and Everton host Manchester United in Monday night's game.

programme.title: Soaring Seagulls : PL Stories
programme.desc: 'Soaring Seagulls' tells the incredible story of Brighton & Hove Albion; from the brink of collapse and years in the lower leagues to becoming one of the Premier League's smartest and most admired clubs. Featuring interviews with the key figures behind Brighton's rise, alongside celebrity fans who followed every twist along the way, this documentary charts a remarkable journey of survival, ambition and one of the greatest comebacks in modern football.

programme.desc: Ahead of the World Cup, we revisit the rise of current USA manager Mauricio Pochettino's unforgettable Tottenham Hotspur side; the team that transformed Spurs from top-four hopefuls into genuine challengers at home and in Europe. Playing fearless, high-intensity football and built around a young core of stars, Pochettino's Spurs came within touching distance of Premier League and Champions League glory, creating some of the club's greatest modern nights along the way. Through exclusive interviews with Pochettino and the key players who drove that era, we tell the story of a team that changed expectations forever and ask how something so promising ultimately fell apart.

programme.desc: Battle for Haditha menggambarkan kembali peristiwa tragis yang terjadi di Haditha, Irak, pada tahun 2005. Cerita disampaikan melalui berbagai sudut pandang, termasuk para prajurit Marinir Amerika Serikat yang menghadapi serangan pemberontak serta warga sipil Irak yang terjebak dalam situasi konflik. Setelah sebuah bom pinggir jalan menewaskan seorang anggota Marinir, ketegangan meningkat hingga berujung pada tragedi yang menimbulkan banyak korban. Film ini menggambarkan dampak perang terhadap manusia, dilema moral, dan konsekuensi dari kekerasan dalam konflik bersenjata.

programme.title: Jangan Ya Dek Ya, Dia Pilih Pemeran Utama
programme.desc: Vina ini akan dijodohkan dengan seorang pria tampan bernama Ray. Namun dia menolak, dan dia ingin menggantikan posisinya dan menyuruh sahabat karibnya penjual es duren, bernama Dila. Dila akhirnya menyamar sebagai Vina di sana. Sayangnya, tidak hanya Dila yang menyamar, tetapi ternyata Rei juga diperankan oleh tokoh pengganti bernama Kenan, yang merupakan sahabat karibnya. Pada akhirnya Kenan dan Dilla ini bertemu, dan mereka pun mengaku dengan nama yang lain.

programme.desc: Bimantara yang mendekati Livia demi menyabet jabatan mentereng di perusahaannya. Ternyata kehadiran Bimantara membawa aura positif bagi Livia yang baru putus dari mantannya. Sang mantan bernama Devan diketahui selingkuh dengan rival bisnisnya, Marsya. Bimantara ikut membantu Livia membuktikan bahwa Devan bermain belakang. Bagaimana kisah selanjutnya?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Menir Si Proyek Gagal
programme.desc: Diceritakan seorang gadis dari pelosok brebes, dimana kehidupannya selalu di isi dengan mburuh di ladang bawang bersama nenek- nenek di kampungnya.? padahal bapaknya pengin sekali Menir terbang ke luar negeri jadi TKW yang sukses mengangkat hidup keluarganya seperti si Tuti dan sanem dua sahabatnya yang telah lebih dulu menjadi TKW. Apalagi Tuti yang baru saja pulang dari luar negeri dengan banyak uang, oleh- oleh dan juga anak dalam kandungan yang tak jelas siapa Bapaknya. Menir jelas tak suka, baginya uang bisa di cari di mana saja, tak perlu harus ke luar negeri, apalagi cerita suram yang dia dengar dari teman- temannya yang pernah jadi TKW semakin membuatnya malas luar biasa.

programme.desc: Dalam upaya memperkuat gugatan kematian tidak wajar, Matty dan Sarah menjalankan penyamaran sebagai nenek dan cucu untuk menyusup ke sebuah panti lansia. Di saat yang sama, tim hukum harus menyusun strategi terbaik untuk mengungkap fakta di balik kasus tersebut, menghadirkan drama hukum yang dipenuhi ketegangan, kecerdikan, dan kejutan.

programme.title: The Hand That Robbed..., Ep 3
programme.desc: The Hand That Robbed the Cradle mengulas kembali kisah nyata penculikan Delimar Vera, bayi yang dinyatakan meninggal setelah kebakaran rumah yang mencurigakan pada tahun 1997. Melalui wawancara eksklusif, rekaman arsip, dan penelusuran investigatif, dokumenter tiga episode ini mengungkap bagaimana berbagai kejanggalan akhirnya membawa pada penemuan bahwa Delimar masih hidup bertahun-tahun kemudian. Kisah ini menyoroti perjuangan keluarga mencari kebenaran di balik salah satu kasus penculikan anak yang paling mengejutkan di Amerika Serikat.

Mereka dituntut menghadirkan hidangan penutup yang tidak hanya lezat, tetapi juga memiliki teknik yang matang, presentasi yang menarik, dan keseimbangan rasa yang sempurna. programme.title: America's Got Talent S21
programme.desc: Musim ke-21 menghadirkan beragam talenta luar biasa dari seluruh dunia, mulai dari penyanyi, penari, pesulap, komedian, hingga aksi unik lainnya. Para peserta berjuang memukau juri dan penonton demi meraih hadiah utama sebesar 1 juta dolar AS serta kesempatan mengubah hidup mereka.

programme.title: Ghosts S5: Viking Wedding
programme.desc: Woodstone Manor menjadi lokasi pernikahan bertema Viking yang penuh semangat dan keunikan. Di tengah kesibukan Sam dan Jay mempersiapkan acara agar berjalan lancar, para penghuni arwah justru ikut campur dengan berbagai cara yang tak terduga. Beragam kesalahpahaman, aksi kocak, dan gangguan supranatural membuat hari bahagia pasangan pengantin dipenuhi kejutan. Episode "Viking Wedding" menghadirkan perpaduan komedi, romansa, dan kekacauan khas Ghosts yang menghibur.

programme.desc: Para rekrutan menghadapi tantangan baru termasuk menyelamatkan diri dari kecelakaan kapal dan latihan tempur yang intensif.

programme.title: Entertainment Tonight

programme.title: MasterChef S16: Bitter Sweet

Dengan eliminasi yang semakin dekat, hanya peserta dengan kreasi terbaik yang mampu melanjutkan langkah mereka di Global Gauntlet.

programme.title: Sheriff Country S1: Aftermath
programme.desc: Pada episode perdana, Sheriff Mickey Fox menyelidiki dampak dari sebuah insiden besar yang mengguncang kota kecil tempatnya bertugas. Saat penyelidikan berkembang, berbagai petunjuk baru membawa kasus tersebut semakin dekat dengan kehidupan pribadinya, menguji kepemimpinan, naluri, dan dedikasinya sebagai penegak hukum. Di tengah tekanan pekerjaan dan dinamika hubungan keluarga yang rumit, Mickey harus menjaga keamanan masyarakat sambil mengungkap kebenaran. Episode "Aftermath" membuka serial ini dengan perpaduan drama kriminal, misteri, dan ketegangan yang menjanjikan.

programme.title: Pororo'S Thematic Show
programme.desc: Tema cerita Pororo dan kawan-kawan. Anda akan diajak ke desa Porong Porong, sebuah tempat yang penuh dengan petualangan.

programme.title: Arpo
programme.desc: Arpo dirancang sebagai robot komando, dibangun sebagai mesin tempur yang ganas. Namun, dengan tercapainya perdamaian dunia, Arpo telah diperlengkapi kembali untuk pengasuhan, diberi kode ulang untuk dipeluk, dan secara resmi dipindahkan sebagai robot pengasuh!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Serial ini menggambarkan bagaimana karakter-karakter ini selamat dari bahaya kehidupan sehari-hari, secara tidak sengaja mengubah situasi biasa menjadi peristiwa yang tidak terduga, luar biasa, dan selalu lucu.

programme.title: Morphle 2D - English
programme.desc: Ikuti petualangan Mila yang berusia 5 tahun dan hewan peliharaan ajaibnya Morphle, yang dapat berubah menjadi apa pun yang diimpikan Mila!

programme.title: Titipo Titipo 2
programme.desc: Season 2 dari cerita Kereta api kecil yang baru lahir dari Train Center TITIPO baru saja lulus ujian mengemudi dan siap untuk bekerja di Desa Kereta. Meskipun TITIPO bercita-cita menjadi kereta terbaik di dunia, kepribadiannya yang penasaran namun acak menangkapnya dalam peristiwa dan masalah yang tidak terduga setiap hari.

programme.title: Tayo Thematic Show Season 2
programme.desc: Kisah Tayo dan teman-temannya dengan berbagai tema! Kami mengundang Anda ke desa keliling tempat bus-bus kecil berkumpul.

programme.title: Pororo'S Healthy Habits
programme.desc: Halo teman-teman? Saya Pororo! Bisakah kita belajar bersama tentang bagaimana tumbuh sebagai anak yang sehat?

programme.title: Oddbods Season 2
programme.desc: Geng Fuse, Newt, Pogo, Bubbles, Jeff, Zee, dan Slick yang unik dan unik tertawa, menipu, dan menjalani hidup mereka.

programme.title: Masha & The Bear
programme.desc: Seekor beruang sirkus pensiunan menetap di hutan dan bersiap untuk kehidupan baru yang tenang dikelilingi oleh kedamaian dan ketenangan sampai dia diperkenalkan dengan seorang gadis kecil petualang bernama Masha. Masha adalah seorang gadis Rusia yang tinggal di hutan bersama babi, kambing, dan anjingnya.

programme.title: Masha & The Bear

programme.title: Poyo Show
programme.desc: Rasakan kisah Pororo, Tayo dan Tittipo! Hari ini, apa yang akan terjadi pada teman-teman kita?

programme.title: Kertas Ajaib
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru - seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Bedu Dan Adul
programme.desc: Bedu dan Adul adalah sebuah serial film animasi 3D tentang petualangan anak-anak di kawasan pinggiran Jakarta.

programme.title: Detektif Kubi
programme.desc: Rasa ingin tahu mendorong orang untuk belajar! Baru-baru ini, di Hutan Sinar Matahari, banyak hal aneh telah terjadi. Jadi orang-orang meminta bantuan Detektif Kubi. Detektif Kubi, bersama dengan teman-teman mudanya, menemukan petunjuk dalam permainan kata dan membantu teman-teman mereka di hutan untuk memecahkan kasus satu per satu.

programme.title: Jin Qorin
programme.desc: Seno (Marthino Lio) sangat mencintai istrinya Alya (Tyara Vanessa) dan putrinya Reva (Kanaya Gleadys). Tetapi, ada rahasia besar yang harus ditutupi Seno di dalam rumah tangganya

programme.title: Dapil Komeng
programme.desc: Sketsa Komedi yang menceritakan kelucuan Komeng dalam mewujudkan mimpinya dengan cara masuk ke lemari rahasia yang akan membawanya kemana saja dan bertemu siapa saja yang dia inginkan

programme.title: Bisik Hati Lara
programme.desc: LARA sebagai anak sulung, tak punya pilihan selain harus mencari pekerjaan tambahan, demi adik satu- satunya, LENA, bisa melanjutkan SMA nya sampai lulus, sembari memastikan terapi pengobatan Ibu.

programme.title: Brata S2
programme.desc: Pembunuhan brutal terjadi di ATM kampung Sukadamai. Roni harus memimpin penyelidikan karena Brata dipindahkan ke bagian arsip. Sukadamai membawa Brata kembali ke mimpi buruk di masa lalu.

programme.title: Angling Dharma S2
programme.desc: Perpecahan terjadi ketika Kerajaan Malwapati yang dipimpin oleh Prabu Angling Dharma disulut oleh perseteruan dengan Syudawirat untuk memperebutkan.

programme.title: Trip Among Rans
programme.desc: Pergi berlibur ditengah masa PSBB membuat Raffi dan nagita menjadi super heboh dalam mempersiapkan segala kebutuhan liburannya demi mendapatkan liburan yang aman dan tetap nyaman

programme.title: Negeri 5 Menara
programme.desc: Negeri 5 Menara series bercerita tentang Alif, pemuda minangkabau memiliki cita-cita tinggi. Ia ingin sekolah di ITB & menjadi sosok seperti idolanya, B.J. Habibie. Sayangnya keinginan Alif tidak mendapat respon baik dari ibunya.

programme.title: Diary Putih Abu Abu
programme.desc: Sekelompok cewek yang bersekolah di pinggiran Jakarta bertemu dan bersahabat karena memiliki kesamaan. Keakraban mereka mulai dikenal karena konten yang sering mereka posting di social media.

programme.title: Akhir Kisah Si Doel
programme.desc: Kepulangan Sarah bersama Dul ke Jakarta, disambut bahagia oleh keluarga Doel. Namun hal tersebut juga membuat Zaenab, Sarahdan Doel dihadapkan pada dilemma untuk menentukan pilihan.

programme.title: CLBK The Series

programme.title: Apose S2

programme.title: Tiba - Tiba Berondong
programme.desc: Bella, dosen psikologi 35 tahun yang mapan namun kesepian. Di dorong dengan tekanan keluarga, ia menggunakan aplikasi kencan & bertemu Langit, pria jenaka ternyata baru 19 tahun dan menjadi mahasiswa barunya, memicu dilema asmara.

programme.title: Waktunya Srimulat Bercyanda

programme.title: Leiden

programme.title: Ikhlas Paling Serius
programme.desc: Drama romantis yang mengikuti Fajar, seorang people pleaser yang menjadi asisten pribadi Farah, CEO perfeksionis. Fajar terjebak dilema saat ditugaskan memata-matai Farah, namun justru jatuh cinta dan terlibat konflik rumit.

programme.title: Isyarat
programme.desc: Angkie dilahirkan sebagai gadis yang cantik dan normal. Namun, pada usia 10 tahun tiba-tiba pendengarannya berkurang secara drastis. Dokter memvonisnya kehilangan pendengaran selamanya.

programme.title: Montase
programme.desc: Program magazine tentang movie & series review, menghadirkan para cast dan mengkombinasikan game show

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta
programme.desc: Berkisah tentang 2 bersaudara Andin dan Elsa yang tanpa sengaja mencintai pria yang sama yaitu Nino. Hubungan mereka berdua yang memang tidak pernah baik menjadi semakin buruk setelah Nino menikah dengan Andin.

programme.title: Kupu Malam
programme.desc: Laura adalah seorang mahasiswi cantik dan pintar yang bekerja sebagai pelacur. Salah satu kliennya terobsesi padanya, tetapi dia menolaknya karena prinsipnya. Dia mencoba memulai hidup baru, tetapi masa lalu terus mengejarnya.

programme.title: Dunia Tanpa Tuhan
programme.desc: Oki, seorang mahasiswa abadi yang hidup di pinggiran Jakarta. Di tengah desakan untuk segera wisuda, ia jatuh cinta pada Azizah. Muncul Jahal yang mati suri mengaku sebagai Wali dan memanfaatkan kepolosan warga dengan membuka praktik pengobatan.

programme.title: Jatanras
programme.desc: Program tayangan Jatarnas memilki fokus pada peliputan criminal yang dikemas secara ringan

programme.title: Customs Protection
programme.desc: Program acara realitas yang menampilkan keseharian beberapa petugas bea dan cukai, tidak hanya menyaksikan aksi Bea Cukai Indonesia dalam penggerebekan, tetapi kita juga diajak untuk menyaksikan kejadian yang sesungguhnya terjadi di lapangan.
Di program 86, pemirsa akan diajak bersama melihat keseharian beberapa anggota polisi.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. programme.title: Mr. Player
programme.desc: Mr. Player mengisahkan Pun yang kembali ke Thailand setelah tunangannya melarikan diri membawa seluruh tabungannya. Dalam upaya mencari pelaku, ia mendekati Ploy, seorang aktris ternama yang juga merupakan adik sang buronan. Pencarian tersebut perlahan membuka berbagai rahasia, kebohongan, dan konspirasi yang tidak pernah mereka duga. Di tengah konflik yang semakin rumit, hubungan keduanya berkembang menjadi kisah yang menguji kepercayaan, keberanian, dan arti cinta yang sesungguhnya.

programme.title: Father's Wish
programme.desc: Father's Wish mengisahkan perjalanan emosional seorang ayah yang rela berkorban demi kebahagiaan keluarganya. Di tengah berbagai cobaan hidup yang datang silih berganti, ia berusaha menepati sebuah janji penting yang diyakininya dapat memberikan harapan dan masa depan yang lebih baik bagi orang-orang yang dicintainya. Kisah ini menghadirkan makna tentang kasih sayang orang tua, pengorbanan, keteguhan hati, dan pentingnya menjaga ikatan keluarga dalam menghadapi berbagai tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: Blessing Of Formosa
programme.desc: Blessing of Formosa merupakan program budaya dan perjalanan yang memperkenalkan keindahan tradisi rakyat Taiwan. Setiap episode mengunjungi kuil-kuil bersejarah, perayaan keagamaan, dan komunitas lokal untuk mengungkap kisah para dewa, adat istiadat, kerajinan tradisional, hingga kuliner khas daerah. Dengan penyajian yang ringan dan menghibur, acara ini tidak hanya memperkenalkan destinasi wisata, tetapi juga melestarikan nilai-nilai budaya serta warisan spiritual yang menjadi bagian penting dari identitas masyarakat Taiwan.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz menghadirkan berbagai informasi terkini seputar industri hiburan, mulai dari kabar selebritas, film, serial televisi, musik, hingga gaya hidup. Program ini juga menyuguhkan liputan di balik layar, wawancara eksklusif dengan para artis, serta ulasan mengenai tren dan peristiwa terbaru di dunia entertainment. Dengan penyajian yang ringan dan informatif, Show Biz menjadi sumber informasi bagi penonton yang ingin mengikuti perkembangan industri hiburan.

programme.title: The Borderless World
programme.desc: The Borderless World menghadirkan laporan mendalam mengenai berbagai peristiwa internasional, mulai dari politik, ekonomi, teknologi, budaya, hingga isu sosial yang berkembang di berbagai belahan dunia. Melalui peliputan langsung, wawancara, dan analisis yang komprehensif, program ini memberikan perspektif yang lebih luas terhadap berbagai isu global sekaligus menyoroti dampaknya terhadap kehidupan masyarakat.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour mengajak para selebritas untuk berkompetisi menyusun rencana perjalanan dengan tema dan anggaran tertentu. Dalam setiap episode, mereka mengunjungi berbagai destinasi wisata, mencicipi kuliner khas, serta memperkenalkan tempat-tempat menarik yang layak dikunjungi. Melalui pengalaman seru, interaksi yang menghibur, dan rekomendasi perjalanan yang praktis, program ini memberikan inspirasi wisata bagi para penonton.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night merupakan salah satu acara variety paling populer di Taiwan. Dipandu oleh Jacky Wu bersama Chen Han-Dian dan Lulu Huang, setiap episode menghadirkan bintang tamu dari dunia hiburan untuk mengikuti berbagai permainan kreatif, tantangan bertema, penampilan musik, hingga segmen komedi yang mengundang tawa. Dengan perpaduan hiburan, kompetisi, dan interaksi spontan antar selebritas, acara ini telah menjadi favorit pemirsa serta meraih berbagai penghargaan bergengsi, termasuk Golden Bell Awards.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

Acara ini memberikan gambaran komprehensif mengenai kinerja dan kebijakan pemerintah. programme.desc: The great return to the stage of a legend of French rap! Born in the effervescence of the 1990s in Marseille, Fonky Family bursts onto the French music scene like a hurricane. Hard-hitting lyrics, captivating rhythms, and more than 1.2 million albums sold. In September 2024, FF delivered an anthology concert.

programme.title: GOLDEN COAST FESTIVAL 2024
programme.desc: Golden Coast Festival 2024 menjadi tonggak penting dalam sejarah musik Prancis sebagai festival besar pertama yang berfokus sepenuhnya pada genre rap. Diselenggarakan di Corcelles-les-Monts, dekat Dijon, acara ini mempertemukan puluhan ribu penggemar dengan para bintang rap ternama serta talenta baru dari berbagai wilayah Prancis. Melalui rangkaian konser yang energik, festival ini menampilkan keragaman gaya dan generasi dalam musik hip-hop Francophone. Selain menjadi ajang hiburan, festival ini juga merayakan pengaruh budaya rap terhadap gaya hidup, kreativitas, dan identitas generasi muda, menjadikannya salah satu perhelatan musik paling penting di Prancis.

programme.title: Golden Coast Festival 2024
programme.desc: Yame is 100% self-taught and launched his solo career in March 2020 after starting out as a keyboardist and singer in Paris jam sessions. On stage, his singular, powerful voice and his ease give his unclassifiable music and performance an organic identity.

The four best friends set their heading for adventure, confronting their fears and working together to solve all their problems.

programme.title: Gigantosaurus
programme.desc: Rocky, Bill, Tiny dan Mazu adalah empat dinosaurus muda yang tumbuh pada periode Cretaceous. Mereka sekawanan dinosaurus yang selalu mencari petualangan baru di setiap tempat yang mereka kunjungi. Gunung berapi baru bermunculan setiap saat, brachiosaurus berleher panjang dan triceratops raksasa berkeliaran bebas, hujan meteor menerangi langit malam dan Gigantosaurus yang ganas menguasai semuanya. Bisakah mereka berteman dengan Giganto, sang Raja Dinosaurus.

programme.title: L'AFRIK EN CONTES
programme.desc: L'AFRIK EN CONTES menghidupkan kembali dongeng tradisional Afrika melalui animasi penuh warna dan penceritaan yang menarik. Setiap episode menyampaikan pesan moral, humor, dan warisan budaya, memperkenalkan penonton muda pada tokoh-tokoh legendaris serta kebijaksanaan turun-temurun.

programme.title: Les Quiquoi
programme.desc: Olive, Petole, Boulard, Mixo, Raoul and Pamela make up a full-of-fun gang known as the Quiquoi. Together they ask a host of existential questions, using drawings to find the answers. In their own quirky way, they love nothing better than creating surrealist worlds where everything becomes possible.

programme.title: API !
programme.desc: Api ! mengisahkan keseharian Api, seorang siswi cerdas dan bertanggung jawab, bersama teman-temannya di lingkungan sekolah dasar. Setiap episode menghadirkan cerita tentang persahabatan, tantangan belajar, konflik kecil, hingga petualangan yang membantu mereka tumbuh menjadi pribadi yang lebih baik. Melalui berbagai situasi yang dekat dengan kehidupan anak-anak, serial ini mengajarkan nilai-nilai penting seperti kejujuran, rasa tanggung jawab, empati, dan kerja sama. Dengan pendekatan yang ringan dan menghibur, Api ! menjadi tontonan edukatif yang membantu anak-anak memahami dunia sosial di sekitar mereka.

programme.title: Rocky & Lily : C'Est Dans La Boite !
programme.desc: Every day, Rocky and Lily receive a new box on the set. But what does it contain? It's always a surprising object that leads them to discover very different subjects: turtles, bowling or even cloud formation.

programme.title: ROCKY & LILY : C'EST DANS LA BOÎTE !
programme.desc: Rocky & Lily : C’est dans la Boîte ! mengajak anak-anak berimajinasi melalui petualangan kreatif yang lahir dari benda sehari-hari.

programme.title: DRAZILION
programme.desc: Drazilion mengisahkan petualangan Oli, Emma, Fabio, dan Rachel yang menjelajahi dunia fantasi bernama Virmark. Berbekal rasa ingin tahu dan semangat petualangan, mereka berusaha menemukan Drazilion, makhluk legendaris yang diyakini sebagai induk dari seluruh makhluk yang hidup di dunia tersebut. Sepanjang perjalanan, mereka bertemu berbagai spesies unik, menghadapi tantangan yang tidak terduga, serta memecahkan masalah bersama. Setiap petualangan mengajarkan nilai-nilai penting seperti keberanian, persahabatan, kerja sama, dan kepedulian terhadap lingkungan. Dengan perpaduan fantasi, humor, dan aksi yang ringan, serial animasi ini menghadirkan pengalaman yang menghibur sekaligus edukatif bagi anak-anak.

programme.title: LES SECRETS DU FINISTÈRE
programme.desc: Les Secrets du Finistère mengisahkan Morgane Le Dantec yang kembali ke Brittany dan terlibat dalam penyelidikan setelah ditemukannya tulang-belulang manusia di bawah pohon ek suci yang tumbang akibat badai. Korban ternyata memiliki kaitan dengan tradisi druidisme, sebuah dunia yang pernah dikenal Morgane semasa muda. Dalam upayanya mengungkap kebenaran, ia harus kembali berhadapan dengan teman-teman lama dan berbagai rahasia masa lalu yang selama ini tersembunyi. Memadukan investigasi kriminal dengan mitologi dan legenda khas Brittany, film ini menghadirkan misteri yang penuh ketegangan sekaligus menyingkap hubungan antara masa lalu dan masa kini.

programme.title: LA NUIT DES ROIS
programme.desc: Berlatar di La MACA, sebuah penjara yang terletak di tengah hutan Pantai Gading dan memiliki aturan unik yang dijalankan oleh para narapidana sendiri, La Nuit des Rois mengisahkan seorang tahanan muda yang baru tiba dan ditunjuk sebagai “Roman”, pendongeng yang harus menghibur para penghuni penjara sepanjang malam saat bulan merah terbit. Menyadari bahwa nasibnya bergantung pada kemampuannya mempertahankan cerita hingga fajar, ia mulai menuturkan kisah legendaris tentang Zama King, seorang tokoh kriminal yang hampir menyerupai mitos. Seiring berjalannya malam, cerita yang ia sampaikan berkembang menjadi perpaduan antara kenyataan, legenda, fantasi, dan sejarah, menghadirkan pengalaman sinematik yang unik tentang kekuasaan, tradisi lisan Afrika, serta kekuatan cerita sebagai alat bertahan hidup.

programme.desc: Le Bataillon du Pacifique mengisahkan para sukarelawan muda dari Polinesia Prancis yang memilih meninggalkan pulau-pulau Pasifik untuk bergabung dengan Pasukan Prancis Bebas setelah pendudukan Prancis oleh Jerman Nazi. Menempuh perjalanan ribuan kilometer dari kampung halaman, mereka terlibat dalam berbagai pertempuran penting Perang Dunia II, termasuk Bir Hakeim dan El Alamein. Di tengah kerasnya peperangan, para prajurit ini menghadapi kehilangan, pengorbanan, dan kerinduan akan rumah, sembari membuktikan keberanian mereka dalam perjuangan membebaskan Prancis. Film ini memberikan penghormatan kepada kontribusi para pejuang Pasifik yang sering terlupakan dalam sejarah Perang Dunia II.

programme.desc: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier mengisahkan Kang Seong-jae, seorang pemuda dari keluarga sederhana yang memutuskan masuk militer setelah kematian ayahnya. Meski menjadi lulusan terbaik selama pelatihan, ia justru ditempatkan di bagian dapur karena pengalamannya membantu usaha food truck milik sang ayah. Kehidupannya berubah ketika sebuah sistem misterius layaknya permainan video muncul dan memberinya berbagai misi memasak. Setiap tantangan yang berhasil diselesaikan membuat kemampuan memasaknya berkembang pesat hingga ia menjadi sosok yang dihormati oleh rekan-rekan dan atasannya. Di balik kisah penuh humor dan semangat kebersamaan di barak militer, Seong-jae juga perlahan menemukan petunjuk tentang rahasia yang mungkin berkaitan dengan kematian ayahnya. Serial ini memadukan komedi, fantasi, dunia kuliner, dan kisah pertumbuhan diri dalam sebuah petualangan yang menghibur dan hangat.

programme.title: Mobsters
programme.desc: Hospital emergency room Dr. Daniel "Dan" Challis (Tom Atkins) and Ellie Grimbridge (Stacey Nelkin), the daughter of a murder victim, uncover a terrible plot by small-town mask maker Conal Cochran (Dan O'Herlihy), a madman who's planning a Halloween mass murder utilizing an ancient Celtic ritual. The ritual involves a boulder stolen from Stonehenge, the use of Silver Shamrock masks and a triggering device contained in a television commercial -- all designed to kill millions of children.

programme.title: SPECIAL ID [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ma Le, a psychologist who calls himself a "suicide intervention master," makes money off the misfortunes of others. One day, a "birthday star" falls from the sky and hits Ma Le. Having accidentally inhaled divine energy, Ma Le is told that the world is on the verge of collapse and that only by gathering the four gods of wind, rain, thunder, and lightning, who have been banished to the mortal realm, can everything be changed. Thus, the gods and mortals embark on a hilarious, fantastical, and thrilling journey...

Lizzie finds a kindred spirit in the live-in maid, Bridget, and friendship soon blossoms into a secret romance. But tension mounts in the Borden household, leading to a violent breaking point.

programme.title: Married to the Mob
programme.desc: Angela de Marco (Michelle Pfeiffer) is fed up with her gangster husband's (Alec Baldwin) line of work and wants no part of the crime world. When her husband is killed for having an affair with the mistress of mob boss Tony "The Tiger" Russo (Dean Stockwell), Angela and her son depart for New York City to make a fresh start. Unfortunately, Tony has set his sights upon Angela -- and so has an undercover FBI agent (Matthew Modine) looking to use her to bust Tony.

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) get blindsided by an unexpected visit from Mark's cousin, Fred (John Diehl), and his pregnant wife, Bernice (Jessica Lundy). The family reunion is suddenly extended from five days to six months after an accident renders Bernice bedridden, and Mark and Jessie's life is slowly turned upside down by a seemingly never-ending stream of house guests, including Jessie's neurotic sister (Alison La Placa) and her obnoxious son (Bradley Gregg).

programme.title: Cadillac Man
programme.desc: Car dealer Joey O'Brien (Robin Williams) is spread as thin financially as he is in his love life. He's dating more women than he can remember, and the local toughs he's borrowed money from want it back. In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage.

programme.title: Drowning Mona
programme.desc: The recently deceased Mona Dearly was many things: an abusive wife, a domineering mother, a loud-mouthed neighbor and a violent malcontent. So when her car and corpse are discovered in the Hudson River, police Chief Wyatt Rash immediately suspects murder rather than an accident. But, since the whole community of Verplanck, N.Y., shares a deep hatred for this unceasingly spiteful woman, Rash finds his murder investigation overwhelmed with potential suspects.

programme.title: Red 2
programme.desc: Former CIA black-ops agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) and his old partner, Marvin Boggs (John Malkovich), are caught in the grip of retirement -- but that soon changes when a powerful Cold War weapon known as Nightshade resurfaces decades after its disappearance. With assassins hot on their trail, Frank and his team set out to find the one scientist (Anthony Hopkins) who can unravel the mystery of Nightshade and help them save themselves -- and the world.

programme.title: Operation Fortune: Ruse de guerre
programme.desc: Elite spy Orson Fortune must track down and stop the sale of a deadly new weapons technology wielded by billionaire arms broker Greg Simmonds. Reluctantly teamed up with some of the world's best operatives, Fortune and his crew recruit Hollywood's biggest movie star, Danny Francesco, to help them on their globe-trotting mission to save the world.

programme.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
programme.desc: Unfulfilled and facing financial ruin, actor Nick Cage accepts a $1 million offer to attend a wealthy fan's birthday party. Things take a wildly unexpected turn when a CIA operative recruits Cage for an unusual mission. Taking on the role of a lifetime, he soon finds himself channeling his most iconic and beloved characters to save himself and his loved ones.

programme.title: The Spy Who Dumped Me
programme.desc: Best friends Audrey and Morgan are going about their humdrum lives in Los Angeles -- until Audrey's ex-boyfriend suddenly shows up with a team of deadly assassins on his trail. Unexpectedly thrust into an international conspiracy, the gals soon find themselves dodging killers and a suspicious British agent while hatching a plan to save the world.

programme.title: Red
programme.desc: After surviving an assault from a squad of hit men, retired CIA agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) reassembles his old team for an all-out war. Frank reunites with old Joe (Morgan Freeman), crazy Marvin (John Malkovich) and wily Victoria (Helen Mirren) to uncover a massive conspiracy that threatens their lives. Only their expert training will allow them to survive a near-impossible mission -- breaking into CIA headquarters.

programme.title: Red 2

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

programme.title: Rambo
programme.desc: Having long-since abandoned his life as a lethal soldier, John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) lives a solitary life near the Thai border. Two weeks after guiding a missionary (Julie Benz) and her comrades into Burma, he gets an urgent call for help. The missionaries have not returned, and although he is reluctant to embrace violence again, Rambo sets out to rescue the captives from the Burmese army.

programme.title: Rambo: Last Blood
programme.desc: Vietnam War veteran John Rambo tries to find some semblance of peace by raising horses on a ranch in Arizona. He's also developed a special familial bond with a woman named Maria and her teenage granddaughter Gabriela. But when a vicious Mexican cartel kidnaps Gabriela, Rambo crosses the border on a bloody and personal quest to rescue her and punish those responsible.

programme.title: Silent Night
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve, a man witnesses the death of his young son when the boy gets caught in crossfire between warring gangs. Recovering from a wound that cost him his voice, he soon embarks on a bloody and grueling quest to punish those responsible.

programme.title: Cold Pursuit
programme.desc: Nels Coxman's quiet life as a snowplow driver comes crashing down when his beloved son dies under mysterious circumstances. His search for the truth soon becomes a quest for revenge against a psychotic drug lord named Viking and his sleazy henchmen. Transformed from upstanding citizen to cold-blooded vigilante, Coxman unwittingly sets off a chain of events that includes a kidnapping, a series of deadly misunderstandings and a turf war between Viking and a rival boss.

programme.title: Mister Rogers' Neighborhood
programme.desc: Mister Rogers reads a book about a dog named Zak. There's also a video visit to the Center for Creative Play, a place where children of all abilities can play.

programme.title: Mister Rogers' Neighborhood
programme.desc: Marilyn Barnett brings someone who has great talent with yo-yos. Mister Rogers shows a film of how people make wooden yo-yos. Prince Tuesday plays well with the yo-yo, but King Friday does not. Therefore, the king outlaws yo-yos.

programme.title: Mister Rogers' Neighborhood

programme.title: Mister Rogers' Neighborhood

programme.title: Mister Rogers' Neighborhood

programme.title: Mister Rogers' Neighborhood

programme.title: Mister Rogers' Neighborhood

programme.desc: The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they're not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can't fend off Iron Man and Ultron's Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man's suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron's control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN! Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers' Tower. Ultron's ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they've stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it's on! It's a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?The Avengers prepare for a party with a surprise guest when Ultron crashes the preparations by using mind control on Iron Man. While trying to rescue their leader, the rest of the team discovers that Baron Stucker, HYDRA, and Yellowjacket are in on Ultron's plans. While preparing for a party at Avengers' Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he's taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man's armor and they fly off!

programme.title: The Book Of Obsession
programme.desc: The Knights are tasked with protecting the King's valuable Ned Knights comic book during the Bookingheim Knight-a-Con. But with all the costumed kids there, will they recognize the real Jestro and Book of Monsters coming to get them? King Halbert instructs the Knights that they must take his valuable Ned Knights comic book to the “Knight-a-Kon” in Bookingham. It will be the first be first prize at the Knight-a-Kon. But the Book of Monsters wants the book, too. Having devoured Ned Knightly comic books in it's down time it has become fanatically obsessed with the storyline. General Magmar suggests they simply attack the place and take what they want, but Jestro tells them they can't: everyone will be in costume and they'll be thousands of comics there. This calls for a clever “infiltration” mission (which will also allow Jestro to see the Kon, which he's always wanted to do.) So Jestro goes into the Kon with the BOM and some monsters. And it's easy because everyone is in costume Jestro, the BOM and their monsters fit right in at the convention and Clay and crew have their work cut out for them trying to separate fiend from fan. Macy keeps going on-and-on about the story in the King's comic book as the Knights keep a watchful eye on it. Robin even shows up in the “Minitrex” – a small version of the Fortrex he built just for the Knight-a-Kon. He's convinced he can win the costume competition that is the big closing event for the Kon. At the end of the Kon there's a big awards ceremony for “Best Costume.” The prize: “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1.” The BOM must get it and scheme to get closer to it during the costume contest. He's just…about…to get the book when…the impatient Magmar attacks! Everyone thinks it's part of the big show! “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1” is tossed from person-to-person-to-person in the melee. The Knights must do something, but they're too far away from the Fortrex to download any NEXO-Power. Robin pulls up in his Minitrex they can use it to get NEXO-Power! Robin wins the best costume for his Minitrex and wins the Ned Knightly Comic which he then gives to Macy…she deserves to read it.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu
programme.desc: Finally, after 1978's I Spit On Your Grave shocked the world with its story of a beautiful career woman assaulted and left for dead, and her notorious revenge on those responsible, cinema's most lethal Lady Vengeance returns in the most anticipated sequel of all time. Reuniting star Camille Keaton and original director Meir Zarchi, I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu sends now successful writer Jennifer Hills hurtling back to where it all began - to face the wrath of the families of those she murdered. Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. Hailed as a feminist revenge masterpiece by some, and misunderstood as crude exploitation by others, revenge is about to come full circle in Deja Vu, the final chapter in cinema's most shocking cult franchise.

programme.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Joe likes the ladies and gets to meet a variety of them in his job as a taxi driver. From dizzy young women to frustrated housewives, Joe fancies them all, and they take a fancy to Joe. If only things were smoother at home for the put-upon cabbie. With his nagging mother, thieving teenage brother, and the attentions of an overbearing girlfriend with ideas of marriage, Joe leaves the homestead and rents the spare room at his best mate's flat. Meanwhile, he continues to find himself in an assortment of humorous sexual escapades until he accidentally becomes embroiled in a jewel heist that doesn't quite go to plan.

programme.title: Love Finds You in Sugarcreek
programme.desc: A father and son fleeing a shocking and brutal tragedy settle in the predominantly Amish town of Sugarcreek, Ohio. They are taken in by three sisters who offer the father work as a handyman, but a local policewoman begins to become suspicious of his past.

programme.title: Love on Trend
programme.desc: When Allie left her small town to move to San Francisco to pursue her dream of becoming a fashion designer, little did she imagine that the city had big plans for her - and for her heart.

Their brief time apart lays bare the attachment that is growing between them.

programme.title: Romance In The Air
programme.desc: After learning her marketing job is on the line, Eden returns to Lake Tahoe where she used to spend her summers growing up. Intending to relax and recharge so she can tackle her job again, she is surprised to find her childhood friend and sweetheart Riley is still living next door. She finds purpose in helping Riley propel his struggling hot air balloon tour company, and also finds herself drawn to him and their dear past. However, Eden sees Riley and Tahoe as temporary, while her life—and boyfriend—back home await her. She can't admit that she and Riley could have a future, even if that's exactly what she wants. When she's willing to take a risk for what her heart wants, her life will take off with her true love.

programme.title: India Sweets and Spices
programme.desc: When Alia returns home from university, she challenges her parents' elitist lifestyle expensive jewellery, lavish dinner parties, and gossiping aunties. But when she invites the son of a local shopkeeper to her mother's upcoming soiree, family secrets begin to surface.

programme.title: The Hustle
programme.desc: Josephine Chesterfield (Anne Hathaway) is a glamorous, seductive Brit with a penchant for defrauding gullible wealthy men. Into her well-ordered world bursts Penny Rust (Rebel Wilson), an Aussie who is as free-form and fun-loving as Josephine is calculated and cunning.

programme.title: Leaves of Grass
programme.desc: After being told his twin brother has been murdered, teacher Bill returns to his hometown, only to find his scheming brother is actually alive and well, and is actually plotting against a local crime lord - with a little help from Bill.

programme.title: Daniel's Gotta Die
programme.desc: After his father dies, Daniel Powell travels to the Cayman Islands to try to reconnect with the rest of his family. His plan hits a snag though when his siblings decide to try to kill him for his inheritance. Trapped, he'll learn what family means - even if it kills him.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: When Chef Carl Casper suddenly quits his job at a prominent Los Angeles restaurant, he is left to figure out what's next. Finding himself in Miami, he teams up with his ex-wife, his friend and his son to launch a food truck.

programme.title: Django Meets Sartana
programme.desc: The small desert town of Black City is held in a reign of terror by a nasty gang of criminals lead by the ruthless Bud Willer.

programme.title: Scalps

The sage man refuses, and the Southerners massacre the tribe and abduct the young squaw anyway. The noble squaw manages to escape, and hides out with a rough rancher, who dislikes Indians, but hates the Southerners more. The odd couple joins forces, and tactics, to exert ultimate vengeance on the men at the fort.

programme.title: Last of the Renegades
programme.desc: As tensions rise between settlers and the Assiniboins, Winnetou works to preserve peace. A corrupt oilman, Bud Forrester, stages attacks to spark a war and seize oil-rich Native land. Joined by Old Shatterhand and Lord Castlepool, Winnetou must expose the conspiracy before violence becomes inevitable.

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: After robbing a Mexican bank, Dad Longworth takes the loot and leaves his partner Rio to be captured but Rio escapes and searches for Dad in California.

programme.title: Odd Thomas

programme.title: Turbo Kid
programme.desc: An orphaned teenager who goes on an adventure to save his female-robot companion from the hands of an evil warlord who controls the only water supply.

programme.title: Arrowhead
programme.desc: A tech is sprung from prison by a revolutionary leader who promises him an opportunity to save his father from a scheduled execution if he completes a data-stealing mission. But it goes awry, stranding him on a strange alien moon.

programme.desc: A flight from Los Angeles to Tokyo is rocked by turbulence—and a terrifying force is unleashed in this spine-chilling journey into fear from the director of The Grudge.

programme.desc: Alderney, UK. 1964. A telephone operator ends up being the pivotal piece of a drama unfurling which puts professional integrity, and relationships, to the test.

programme.title: Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Outside a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul (Antonio Banderas), a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay.

programme.title: On the Line
programme.desc: A provocative radio host (Mel Gibson) must play a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a mysterious caller who has kidnapped his family.

programme.title: Frozen Ground
programme.desc: An Alaska State Trooper partners with a young woman who escaped the clutches of serial killer Robert Hansen to bring the murderer to justice. Based on actual events.

programme.title: Cross of Voodoo
